newsitem.title: UK: European cotton buying quiet, Portugal bucks trend.
newsitem.headline: European cotton buying quiet, Portugal bucks trend.

text.p: Cotton buyers in Portugal shifted their attention to second quarter availability with a spectrum of qualities attracting interest, industry sources said on Wednesday.
Most other west European raw cotton markets occupied themselves with price-testing in the search for alternatives to better quality Central Asian origins, said likely to be in erratic supply.
Traders reported that West African, Greek and Middle Eastern descriptions were proving to be the most popular choices so far, but a few buyers were also looking at selected U.S. styles.
